summary: Astraeos ascension requires both Abyssalus, the underwater Kraken, and Shallocis, the surface Kraken fought with ships. Defeating only one does not complete the ascension pair.
sharedPreparation: Record difficulty, Single Player Settings and mods before comparing your army with official-server videos.
Start with Gamma; measure health, ammunition and saddle losses before raising difficulty. Total creature level is not a substitute for actual stats.
Keep a breeding pair and spare equipment at base. Fully heal the team and rehearse whistle groups before summoning.
Check tribute, permitted creatures, timer and rewards at the current ASA terminal; do not copy ASE requirements.
Abyssalus requires aquatic or amphibious creatures, cold protection and SCUBA; prepare spare diving gear.
Shallocis needs a prepared ship, cannon ammunition, steering practice and repair reserves. The underwater team is a separate project.

steps.title: 1 · Astral Souls and minibosses
steps.reason: Collect Astral Souls from Astral creatures. Colossus and Kroaratos each require 10; Abyssalus requires 20 / 50 / 100 for Gamma / Beta / Alpha, alongside its other tributes.

steps.title: 2 · Guardian trophies
steps.reason: Prepare the difficulty-matched Natrix, Thodes and Hydraskos trophies required by both Kraken portals. Confirm the complete tribute set at the terminal.

steps.title: 3 · Abyssalus underwater
steps.reason: Destroy every tentacle to remove the barrier, then damage the body. Control shark and squid minions while keeping the sea team together.

steps.title: 4 · Shallocis and paired ascension
steps.reason: Bring ships and clear tentacles to expose the body. Deal with hostile vessels and seeking orbs while positioning for the short damage window. Both Kraken victories complete ascension without a cutscene or upload.

loadouts.entry: Use a coordinated aquatic team in the cold underwater arena.
loadouts.warning: No numeric army thresholds are verified here. Check current encounter eligibility and your save settings.

options.title: Megalodon pack + ridden Tusoteuthis
options.team: A bred Megalodon pack for damage; a ridden Tusoteuthis to resist squid grabs.
options.why: The ASA-only boss page recommends the shark pack and Tusoteuthis rider role.
options.play: Clear tentacles before attacking the body. Watch electrified tentacles and minions; protect isolated, low-health tames and your SCUBA supply.
options.confidence: Current Wiki encounter guidance; no independently measured ASA minimum stats or guaranteed win.
